title: Factors associated with consumer behavior in selecting packaged foods with front-of-package nutrition labeling (FOPNL)
core_idea: Obesity and shifting dietary patterns prompted investigation of how front-of-package nutrition labeling (including Indonesia's voluntary 'healthier choice' logo) relates to consumer selection of packaged foods; the study employed an analytical cross-sectional survey of adult social media followers using a self-administered questionnaire and statistical analysis to identify factors associated with label-informed food choice.
tldr: The study aimed to identify factors linked to consumers' selection of packaged foods with front-of-package nutrition labels in Indonesia using a cross-sectional online survey and statistical analysis, situating FOPNL as a strategy to support healthier choices.
